text:
mira: routine scan picked up a plaintext partner webhook secret in prod telemetry logs for partner=acme. redacted in-place. need containment+rotation now.
ops-bot: secret-detect v1.4 triggered: 1 match in prod-telemetry. report: https://internal/reports/3622223333 :warning:
sara: paste redacted line and last seen pls
mira: `2026-03-23T14:02:15Z INFO webhook delivered partner=acme env=prod webhook_key=****REDACTED****` last seen 2026-03-23T14:02:15Z
security_oncall: treat as compromise. immediate: 1) suspend consumers that read the key; 2) rotate our copy and request partner rotate; 3) deny reads to current vault path; 4) enable vault+KMS audit for window; 5) open SEC incident. I'll file SEC-2026-17.
leo: storage context: KV v2 at secret/data/partners/acme/webhook (ver=3). plan: create secret/data/partners/acme/webhook-v4, write new key, canary update consumers, then revoke old. wrap with kms key partner-rotate.
sara: rewrap vs rotate? rewrap insufficient if plaintext left the system. we must rotate and issue a new secret.
mira: partner says they may need ~24h to rotate. we should revoke our outbound token and insert a short-lived proxy token.
security_oncall: proposed quick vault policy to deny old path:
```
vault policy write deny-acme-old - <<'EOF'
path "secret/data/partners/acme/webhook" {
  capabilities = ["deny"]
}
EOF
```
leo: i'll prep a minimal terraform change for policy + k8s roleBinding to point at webhook-v4; will stage to staging first.
sara: rotation script (ops sketch):
```
NEW_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
vault kv put secret/data/partners/acme/webhook-v4 key=$NEW_KEY
# encrypt with gcloud kms partner-rotate and rollout canary
```
ops-bot: CI pipeline `rotations/partners/acme/3622223333` queued by sara
mira: enable vault audit device and confirm GCP audit sink for partner-rotate key; mark affected log retention window for redaction.
security_oncall: post-rotation checklist: delete old KV versions, revoke tokens, scan logs across retention window, export findings to SEC ticket, confirm partner rotation.
sara: tasks: sara->run rotation CI + k8s sync; leo->policy+tf diff; mira->partner comms & redaction timeline; security_oncall->incident tracking & audit hooks. I'll update SEC-2026-17 and ping eng-sre. :thumbsup:
mira: will attach PoA to incident once done. thanks all.
